question: What is the strangest way you ever came into money?
story: I bought a couch for forty dollars and found nineteen thousand dollars zipped inside the cushion. It was a garage sale on a Sunday morning. The woman selling it barely looked at me. I got it home, sat down, and heard paper crinkle under me. I unzipped the cushion and pulled out a freezer bag stuffed with twenties, rubber banded into stacks. I sat on my floor and stared at it for an hour. Then I drove back to return it. She was gone. New owners, empty rooms, house sold two weeks earlier. So I did the annoying honest thing and handed it to the police, and they held it ninety days while they hunted for an owner. Nobody ever came. Here is the twist. On day ninety one they called and told me it was legally mine. I bought a car. I kept the couch. It is hideous and I will never get rid of it.
